p1c1.opener: Plate left (asymptote rosette, 12 petals, gold); denomination I cartouche; epigraph from Hillis set as plate caption
p1c1.rationale: Opens on the year-2000 asymptote (Hillis epigraph, Newton/Nostradamus/Jung forecasts). The curve-to-vertical is the chapter's own central graph.
p1c1.reading: Drop cap in Bodoni; section heads letterspaced small caps; pull-epigraphs in copper rule frame
p1c1.title: The Transition in the Year 2000
p1c1.caption: Plate I · The millennium asymptote

p1c10.opener: Plate left (shadow rosette, 10 petals, copper/oxide); denomination X; Quigley weapons-conditions list set as assay table
p1c10.palette_role: Copper/oxide dominant; bone text on deepened vault ground
p1c10.rationale: Democracy's rarity and its megapolitical preconditions (Quigley); twilight = long shadows. The sundial literalizes the title without cliché sunset gradients.
p1c10.reading: Numbered conditions as engraved list; marginal hour-ticks mark section breaks
p1c10.title: The Twilight of Democracy
p1c10.caption: Plate X · Sundial at dusk

p1c11.opener: Plate left (twin 11-petal rosettes, gold vs seal-red, misregistered); denomination XI; Tanzi corruption epigraph as stamped finding
p1c11.palette_role: Seal-red dominant — the only chapter where red leads; gold demoted to the 'official' layer
p1c11.rationale: Finale on covert criminal capture of the state ('barbarians in disguise', Body Snatchers). A misregistered second seal is the honest visual pun: counterfeit sovereignty.
p1c11.reading: Blockquote findings in seal-red left rule; end-mark is the counterfeit seal glyph
p1c11.title: Morality and Crime in the “Natural Economy” of the Information Age
p1c11.caption: Plate XI · The counterfeit seal

p1c2.opener: Plate left (strata rosette, 4-layer concentric, copper); denomination II; Huizinga epigraph as stratum label
p1c2.palette_role: Copper-dominant (earth/archive ink); gold reserved for the fourth band
p1c2.rationale: 'Waning of the Modern Age' via megapolitical stages; the four-stage stack is the book's load-bearing diagram (stated in ch.1, historicized here).
p1c2.reading: Stage names as margin labels; timeline rule down the left of historical passages
p1c2.title: Megapolitical Transformations in Historical Perspective
p1c2.caption: Plate II · Four stages of society

p1c3.opener: Plate left (furrow rosette, 8 petals stretched, verdigris); denomination III; Genesis epigraph as field inscription
p1c3.palette_role: Verdigris-dominant (first green chapter — agriculture); bone microtext
p1c3.rationale: The Agricultural Revolution as slow-motion violence-logic shift; furrows are the chapter's own paradigm image for how work reshapes power.
p1c3.reading: Agrarian passages carry furrow section-marks; population-density figures in mono
p1c3.title: East of Eden
p1c3.caption: Plate III · The first furrow

p1c4.opener: Plate left (fracture rosette, 9 petals with one displaced, copper/oxide); denomination IV; scandal-roll call set as ledger entries
p1c4.palette_role: Copper/oxide dominant (decay inks); gold only in the intact fragment
p1c4.rationale: 'Death of politics' paralleled with the senile Church; scandal catalogue (ch.4's long roll call) is literally ledger material.
p1c4.reading: Scandal entries as ledger rows (name — charge — fall); politics-etymology passage as gloss plate
p1c4.title: The Last Days of Politics
p1c4.caption: Plate IV · The fallen capital

p1c5.opener: Plate left (rubble rosette, 7 petals irregular, bone/copper); denomination V; de Balsac 1502 money-and-war maxim as foundation stone
p1c5.rationale: The chapter pivots on two demolitions (San Giovanni, Berlin Wall) as megapolitical watersheds; coursed rubble draws both at once.
p1c5.reading: Date stamps in seal red; wall-fall passages in wide measure with rubble break-marks
p1c5.title: The Life and Health of the Nation-State
p1c5.caption: Plate V · Two demolitions: 1495 / 1989

p1c6.opener: Plate left (severed rosette, 12 petals with a cut gap, copper/gold); denomination VI; Munro cyberspace epigraph as the far side of the cut
p1c6.palette_role: Copper/gold split across the cut; verdigris on the information side
p1c6.rationale: Opens at Flint (sit-down strike) to declare industrial coercion anachronistic; the snapped belt stages 'no Chevrolets on the Information Superhighway'.
p1c6.reading: Industrial-age passages in tighter measure; 'Information Age' turn marked by a cut-rule ornament
p1c6.title: The Megapolitics of the Information Age
p1c6.caption: Plate VI · The severed belt

p1c7.opener: Plate left (knot rosette, 16 petals interlaced, verdigris/gold); denomination VII; Barlow control epigraph as knot legend
p1c7.palette_role: Verdigris/gold — the cybereconomy chapter glows patina, not neon
p1c7.rationale: 'Cyberspace transcends locality'; Barlow's seamless anti-sovereign zone. Knotwork keeps it engraved and avoids the generic node-graph cliché.
p1c7.reading: Network passages with knot section-marks; URLs/hosts (e.g. ibm.com) in mono on copper
p1c7.title: Transcending Locality
p1c7.caption: Plate VII · The anti-sovereign knot

p1c8.opener: Plate left (spire rosette, 8 petals rising asymmetric, gold); denomination VIII; performance-profession analogy as prize table
p1c8.palette_role: Gold-dominant (returns-to-talent chapter); copper for the falling median
p1c8.rationale: Winner-take-most earnings (athletics/opera analogy); the spire curve is the chapter's single quantitative image.
p1c8.reading: Distribution claims in mono figures; 'sow/reap' refrain as recurring rubric
p1c8.title: The End of Egalitarian Economics
p1c8.caption: Plate VIII · The earnings spire

p1c9.opener: Plate left (loom rosette, 9 petals rectilinear warp/weft, copper/seal); denomination IX; 'small planet' IBM passage as trade card
p1c9.palette_role: Copper/seal — Luddite chapter runs hot; longest chapter (29k words) gets the densest plate
p1c9.rationale: New Luddites + nationalist reaction to the 'small planet'; the loom is the honest Luddite artifact, and warp/weft suits engraving.
p1c9.reading: Reaction episodes as dated broadsides; Billig nationhood passages in quoted display
p1c9.title: Nationalism, Reaction, and the New Luddites
p1c9.caption: Plate IX · The broken shuttle

A-rupture.arc: The old order breaks: millennium dread, stage theory, the agrarian precedent, politics dying.
A-rupture.ink: Gold → copper → verdigris → oxide: announcement decaying into ruin.

B-dissolution.arc: The nation-state is assayed and found wanting: its health, its megapolitics, its locality, its economics.
B-dissolution.ink: Bone → copper → verdigris → gold: rubble giving way to the cybereconomy gleam.

C-reckoning.arc: Reaction, twilight, and the criminal interregnum: what fills the vacuum.
C-reckoning.ink: Copper/seal → copper/oxide → seal-red: the metal runs hot, then counterfeit.
